basic.name: Frostbolt
basic.description: Deal 184~~0.04~~ damage and Chill the target.

basic.name: Blizzard
basic.description: Bombard an area with 3 waves of ice, dealing 142~~0.04~~ damage each. Damaged enemies are Chilled.

heroic.name: Summon Water Elemental
heroic.description: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62~~0.04~~ damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental. Loses Health over 32 seconds.

heroic.name: Ring of Frost
heroic.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310~~0.04~~ damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

heroic.name: Command Water Elemental
heroic.description: Wills the Water Elemental to attack an enemy or move to an area.

trait.name: Frostbite
trait.description:
Jaina's Abilities Chill targets, Slowing them by 25% and amplifying damage taken from her Abilities by 50%. Lasts 4 seconds.

Quest: Deal Ability damage to Chilled Heroes.

Reward: Upon dealing 12000 damage, unlock the Improved Ice Block Ability, allowing Jaina to become temporarily Invulnerable.

Mythic Reward: Upon dealing 30000 damage, Ice Block upgrades to Ice Cold, allowing Jaina to move and cast while active.

activable.name: Improved Ice Block
activable.description: Activate to place Jaina in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 2.5 seconds. When this effect expires, nearby enemies are Chilled.

activable.name: Icy Veins
activable.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

activable.name: Ice Blink
activable.description: Activate to teleport a short distance and Chill all nearby enemies.

level1.name: Winter's Reach
level1.description: Increase the range and travel speed of Frostbolt by 30%.

level1.name: Lingering Chill
level1.description: Increase the duration of Chill from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.

level1.name: Fingers of Frost
level1.description:
Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to increase Jaina's Mana regeneration by 0.1 per second, up to 2 per second. 

Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, the damage bonus from Frostbite is increased by 10%.

level4.name: Frost Shards
level4.description: Frostbolt will now pierce the first two targets.

level4.name: Arcane Intellect
level4.description:
Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.

Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

level4.name: Frost Armor
level4.description: Enemies that attack Jaina are Chilled. Additionally, every 10 seconds, Jaina gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

level7.name: Ice Lance
level7.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

level7.name: Ice Floes
level7.description: Increase the width of Cone of Cold by 100% and cause each Hero hit to reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, doubled against chilled Heroes, up to a maximum of 8 seconds per use.

level7.name: Icefury Wand
level7.description: Basic Attacks against Chilled enemies deal 50% more damage and lower the cooldown of Blizzard by 1.25 seconds. Doubled against enemy Heroes.

level10.name: Ring of Frost
level10.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310~~0.04~~ damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

level10.name: Summon Water Elemental
level10.description: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62~~0.04~~ damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental. Loses Health over 32 seconds.

level13.name: Storm Front
level13.description: Increase the cast range of Blizzard by 75% and its radius by 30%.

level13.name: Ice Barrier
level13.description: Gain a Shield for 25% of Ability damage dealt to Chilled targets. The shield lasts 4 seconds.

level13.name: Icy Veins
level13.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Snowstorm
level16.description: The damage of the second wave of Blizzard is increased by 50%. The damage of the third wave is increased by 100%.

level16.name: Northern Exposure
level16.description: Enemies damaged by Cone of Cold have their Armor lowered by 25 for 2 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 25%.

level16.name: Numbing Blast
level16.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 0.75 seconds.

level20.name: Cold Snap
level20.description: The center area of Ring of Frost deals 310~~0.04~~ damage and Roots enemies after the outer ring expires. Each enemy Hero hit reduces its cooldown by 15 seconds.

level20.name: Wintermute
level20.description: Increases the cast range of Water Elemental by 40%, and the Water Elemental will now mimic Jaina's Basic Abilities for 40% damage.

level20.name: Ice Blink
level20.description: Activate to teleport a short distance and Chill all nearby enemies.

level20.name: Deep Chill
level20.description: Frostbite's Chill can now stack a second time, slowing targets up to 40%.
